|birth = {{ne|955}}|height = Short|eyes = Brown}}'''Ester Stepashin''' is an [[Aes Sedai]] of the [[Green Ajah]]{{ref|{{twotc}}, Ester Stepashin}}

== Appearance and Personality ==
Ester is under five feet tall, with large brown eyes, a short cap of dark brown curls and a small, upturned nose. She is cute, almost doll-like, which she does not like having pointed out, any more than she enjoys anyone referring to her height.

==Strength and Abilities==
With a strength level is {{opsl|22}}, she is [[Strength in the One Power among Aes Sedai|stong]] for an Aes Sedai. She is strong enough to [[Traveling|Travel]].

Among the [[ten ferrets]], Ester is the second in hierarchy by strength and years of training.

== History ==
Ester is 45 years old. She was born in [[955 NE]] and went to the [[White Tower]] in [[972 NE]]. After spending seven years as a [[novice]] and eight years as [[Accepted]], she was raised to the shawl in {{ne|987}}.

Her father was a shipowner in Illian; she came from a line of shipowners, ship captains and shipbuilders.

She was a novice with [[Siuan Sanche]] and [[Moiraine Damodred]], having arrived in the Tower just a few months before the pair. However, they quickly outstripped her and rose much faster.

When Siuan was raised [[Amyrlin]] at such a young age she openly expressed reservations, earning a stiff penance; she felt no anger over this as she accepted that she had overstepped her bounds. However, this was used as part of her cover as a ferret. Also used was the fact that Siuan has outpaced her as a novice.

She had one [[Warder]] to whom she was married.

==Activities==
She has allied herself with the [[Salidar Aes Sedai]] and was one of the [[ten ferrets]] sent to the [[White Tower]] to spread the rumor that the [[Red Ajah]] set [[Logain]] up as a [[False Dragon]].{{ref/book|7|8}}

When [[Zerah Dacan]] is found out to be a Salidar spy, she gives up Ester's name as well. Ester thus became part of the group that was trying to hunt down the [[Black Ajah]]{{ref/book|8|26}}.

When [[Meidani Eschede]] is freed from her oath of obedience, it can be assumed Ester was as well.

==Trivia==
Ester Stepashin is described only in "The Wheel of Time Companion", she is never mentioned in the main books of the Wheel of Time.
